overrides.reason: The constituency page duplicates 2021 party vote rows above an internally inconsistent legacy turnout block (57,452 registered while recognized 2021 party votes sum to 144,731). The Béni-Mellal province/circumscription electorate was reported as 318,608 registered voters for the 8 September 2021 elections, based on Wilaya data.
overrides.effect: With 318,608 registered, q=53,101.33 for six seats; no list reaches one full quotient and the six largest remainders are exactly RNI, PAM, PI, USFP, MP, PPS, matching the reported six elected lists.

overrides.reason: The secondary results table attaches elected MP Rifaa Maelainine to the 2,036-vote PAM row. Independent elected-member ground truth (TAFRA/Parliament) and L'Economiste's contemporaneous elected list both identify Rifaa Maelainine as PPS. A region has one list per party; therefore the two adjacent PAM/PPS party labels in the secondary transcription are swapped while the vote counts themselves are retained.
overrides.effect: The legal allocation changes from PI/RNI/PAM to PI/RNI/PPS, matching the independently observed three regional MPs without changing any vote count, registered-voter total, seat magnitude, or electoral formula.
